== Title ==
<span lang="ja">エコー基地兵員</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">ホス上にのみ配備する。それ以降はどこにでも移動できる。ホス以外の位置では戦闘力－１。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">エコー基地の防衛部隊は全員、熟練の戦士たちだ。ジェス・アラシェインのような兵員は、寒冷地で帝国軍の戦法に対抗できるように訓練を受けている。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Echo Base Trooper.

'''Lore''' — Echo Base’s defense force is made up of veteran warriors. Troopers such as Jess Allashane train to counter Imperial tactics in cold environments.

'''Game text''' — Deploy only on Hoth. Thereafter, may move anywhere. Power minus 1 at locations outside Hoth.

The Japanese uses location for the power penalty where the English uses site. Both restrict deployment to Hoth.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-echobasetrooper.gif|Original English face]], [[Echo Base Trooper]].</ref>
